regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, keywords
regions.finding: Verified the true review-article title and aggregate Pt/Au benzannulation scope; no individual experiment is reported in the abstract.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction, Fischer–Borsche through rhodium cyclotrimerization discussion
regions.finding: The prose introduces seven established carbazole routes later drawn as Scheme 1 on page 2. They are cited prior literature, not experiments newly performed in this review.
Three further established benzene-ring-forming routes correspond to Scheme 2 on page 2 and are classified as cited literature examples.

unresolved: All introductory routes are generic and omit experiment-specific quantities, yields, and many conditions.
The cited original papers and SI are not associated with this workspace review.

regions.finding: Seven cited carbazole-synthesis routes were inspected arrow by arrow. Multistage panels a/c/d/e remain ordered multistep literature records; alternatives such as chloranil or Pd/C are not combined charges.
Three cited benzene-annulation routes were retained separately: divinylindole electrocyclization/dehydrogenation, allene-mediated cyclization, and dienylindole thermal benzannulation.
The page only motivates the authors' later methodology and starts a sentence continued on page 3; it adds no new experiment beyond Schemes 1–2.

unresolved: Generic R groups prevent unique structures and the review does not print yields or full procedures for these cited routes.

regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 3 upper and lower arrows
regions.finding: The prior PtCl4 intermolecular indole/beta-allenol cyclic-ether reaction and the intramolecular indolyl-allenol carbazole reaction are separate cited literature examples; expected product 2 is retained as envisioned rather than asserted isolated.
The Pt-carbene 1,2-carbon-migration drawing is a proposed mechanism, not preparations of the intermediate or 3A/3B branches.

regions.region: page 3 center-right Scheme 5 and five yield lines
regions.finding: Five distinct PtCl2/toluene/room-temperature cited scope experiments were recorded separately with yields 83/55/83/70/72%; no time or scale was invented.
The PtCl2 61% and AuCl 81% reactions of 1a are different catalyst runs; their complete arrows appear on page 4 and are not merged.

unresolved: The Scheme 3/5 examples omit scale, time or yield basis as noted in their records.
Complex structures remain label-only and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 4 top Table 1 header, reaction arrow, entries 1–13
regions.finding: All thirteen PtCl2 scope rows were inspected from the image and retained independently with exact R1–R5 labels, room-temperature/toluene/5 mol% conditions, row times, and yields.
Separate 1a→3a runs use AuCl 5 mol% (81%, exclusive) or PtCl2 5 mol% (61%) in toluene at room temperature; time, scale, and yield basis are unreported.

regions.region: page 4 bottom Table 2 header, entries 1–6, footnotes a–c
regions.finding: The Au and Pt columns were treated as separate condition runs: six AuCl experiments and three PtCl2 comparators. Footnote b gives 20 mL DCE for entries 5/6; footnote c gives 15 mol% AuCl for entry 6; comparator dashes remain source markers.
Migration-order discussion and the beginning of the DFT-supported mechanism map to Scheme 6 across pages 4–5; no standalone yield was assigned to the qualitative migration order.

unresolved: Table 1 and Pt-comparator rows omit scale or yield basis; Table 2 Au rows omit workup/purification/mass.
The qualitative migration-order claims are not quantified by a measurement basis on this page.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Scheme 6 and mechanism continuation
regions.finding: IM1–IM4, water-assisted proton transfer, dehydration, and 1,2-H migration are a proposed Pt/Au mechanism supported by DFT, not isolated experiments.

regions.region: page 5 upper-right Table 3 entries 1–13 and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: All thirteen cited [IPrAuCl]/AgSbF6 scope rows were recorded separately. Entry 8 uses 3.0 mmol; entries 10/11 preserve 96:4/97:3 ratios; entries 12/13 use 80 °C; yields are isolated.

regions.region: page 5 reaction-development prose and Scheme 7 introduction
regions.finding: The prose supplies substrate class, DCE/4 Å MS catalyst-system context, migration selectivity, and a proposed mechanism continued as Scheme 7 on page 6; it does not create extra experiments beyond Table 3.

regions.region: page 5 lower-right start of total-synthesis section
regions.finding: Biological context and references to Scheme 8 introduce later total syntheses; no additional arrow is visible on this page.

unresolved: Table 3 does not report atmosphere, workup, product masses, or analytical basis for the two ratios.
The review cites deuterium-labeling evidence but the underlying experiment is not shown in pages 1–6.

regions.finding: The benzoate 1,3-migration, allene IM6, vinyl-gold IM7, gold-carbene IM8, dehydration, and 1,2-R4 migration are a proposed mechanism; no intermediate is treated as an isolated preparation.

regions.region: page 6 left-column total-synthesis overview and retrosynthetic prose
regions.finding: The page lists named alkaloid targets and identifies Au-catalyzed cyclization of indolyl methoxyallenols as the key strategy. Scheme 8/9 drawings occur on later pages and are not claimed as inspected here.

Six described transformations were retained separately; the 1a→3a AuCl step links to Equation 1 instead of being duplicated. The printed NBS bromination precursor '1a' conflicts with the immediately preceding carbazole 3a sequence and remains unresolved. The 7-step/21% value is preserved only as an overall methoxypropadiene→siamenol result.
The shared route to 8b and five divergent transformations were recorded individually. Overall 5–7 step yields from methoxypropadiene are route-level outcomes, not final-step yields.
AuCl cyclization 1c→3c and oxidative debenzylation 3c→clausine V are separate transformations; 61% is retained as the three-step overall yield from methoxypropadiene.
The 1d→3d, 3d→11d, and 11d→clausine-N transformations were retained. The clauszoline-K sentence ends after 'potassium' and remains explicitly incomplete; page 7 was not used to complete it.

unresolved: Most page-6 narrative steps omit exact scale, time, temperature, workup, purification, mass, and stage yield.
The bromination precursor is printed as 1a despite the immediately preceding 3a intermediate.
The clauszoline-K description is truncated at the page boundary and was not completed from page 7.
Later Scheme 8–13 drawings are outside the claimed page range.
